# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

**Document Status:** Approved & Authoritative  
**Standard Compliance:** Contributor Covenant Version 2.1, ACM Code of Ethics  
**System Scope:** All contributors, maintainers, and community spaces  
**Enforcement Level:** Non-Negotiable Community Standard (Zero Tolerance for Harassment)  

---

## 1. Executive Pledge & Universal Scope

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in the **Al-Birru School Information System (`albirru-sis`)** ecosystem a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual orientation.

This Code of Conduct governs all digital spaces within this project, including code repositories, pull request reviews, issue discussions, chat channels, and official external institutional representations.

---

## 2. Behavioral Standards Matrix

Community interactions are governed by an orthogonal behavioral matrix distinguishing mandatory professional standards from strictly prohibited conduct:

| Behavioral Dimension | Mandatory Professional Standards | Strictly Prohibited Conduct |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Interpersonal Communication** | Demonstrating empathy, professional courtesy, and constructive framing. | Trolling, derogatory comments, personal attacks, and political disparagement. |
| **Technical Review & Critique** | Offering objective, actionable, and data-driven architectural feedback. | Dismissive critique, insults, passive-aggressive remarks, or ad hominem remarks. |
| **Privacy & Boundary Integrity** | Respecting personal privacy, ethical boundaries, and individual confidentiality. | Doxxing, publishing private email addresses, or unconsented personal data disclosure. |
| **Professional Atmosphere** | Fostering an inclusive, focused, and scholarly engineering environment. | Sexualized language, inappropriate humor, harassment, or unwelcome advances. |

---

## 3. Incident Reporting & Investigation Protocol

Instances of abusive, harassing, or unacceptable behavior must be reported immediately to community leadership via the designated secure channel:

- **Official Escalation Endpoint**: `conduct@albirru.sch.id`
- **Review Commitment**: All reports will be acknowledged within 24 hours and investigated promptly, impartially, and thoroughly.
- **Confidentiality Guarantee**: Community leaders are bound to protect the confidentiality and security of reporting individuals. Retaliation of any form is grounds for immediate permanent exclusion.

---

## 4. Orthogonal Enforcement Ladder

Community leaders enforce consequences through a deterministic, tiered escalation ladder:

| Enforcement Tier | Impact Severity | Violation Definition | Prescribed Consequence |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tier 1** | **Correction** | Unintentional unprofessional communication or unwelcome language. | Written private notice with educational explanation. Voluntary retraction requested. |
| **Tier 2** | **Formal Warning** | Continued violation or isolated intentional breach of professional standards. | Formal written reprimand with mandatory cooling-off period. Monitored interaction. |
| **Tier 3** | **Temporary Suspension** | Serious or sustained pattern of inappropriate behavior, harassment, or hostility. | Time-bound suspension (30 to 90 days) from all repository write access and discussion spaces. |
| **Tier 4** | **Permanent Expulsion** | Systematic harassment, severe threats, doxxing, or demonstrated bad-faith disruption. | Permanent revocation of repository collaborator status and permanent community ban. |

---

## 5. Authoritative References & Attribution

This specification derives from:
1. **Contributor Covenant Version 2.1**: Standard for open-source community behavioral governance ([contributor-covenant.org](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html)).
2. **ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct**: Association for Computing Machinery professional integrity standard.
